_meta.description: Raw materials and currency. Gold is the unit of account. Materials have gold-denominated trade values. Mixed payment: any transaction can be paid in any combination of gold + materials totaling the price. Three paths to any craftable item: buy at a station, mine-and-fabricate, or barter.
_meta.origin: VA economy primitives + ST credit system merged. Currency is gold — same function as prior 'Credits' system, unified naming. Display unit: 'g' (e.g. 50g). Variable name in engine: goldAmount.

currency.name: Gold
currency.description: Universal currency. Accepted at all stations. Cannot be fabricated. The colony authority calls it 'credits' in official documentation. Everyone else calls it gold. This has never been resolved.

materials.name: Metal
materials.description: Common structural material. Found in asteroids and derelicts.
materials.notes: 5 metal = 1g. The bread and butter of fabrication.

materials.name: Scrap
materials.description: Salvaged junk. Barely useful. Better than nothing.
materials.notes: 10 scrap = 1g. The ship computer does not consider scrap a resource. The fabricator disagrees.

materials.name: Minerals
materials.description: Unprocessed mineral ore. Useful in fabrication or tradeable at stations.

materials.name: Exotic Matter
materials.description: Rare material of unclear origin. High trade value. The ship computer has opinions about touching it.
materials.notes: 1 exotic = 2g. Rare. The fabricator can use it but won't tell you what for until you try.

materials.name: Biocomponent
materials.description: Organic material with fabrication applications. Also technically food, though the chef has asked everyone not to test this.
materials.notes: 1 biocomponent = 1g. Required for crop treatment recipes.
